name: Korga the Red-Handed
source_profile: ● Korga the Red-Handed (CE) is Urzak's principal war captain, notorious for burning settlements that refuse tribute. She commands the Host's most aggressive raiding parties and hopes eventually to replace Urzak.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 50 (source excerpt; may be partial)
